decisions.reason: Burial is verified but the only business inter anchor does not establish a relevant funeral or burial context; do not import this specialist merely through a homonym.
The sole entry repeats innovative and does not supply a self-contained explanation of the proposed new-ideas meaning.
The biological inoculation material and metallurgical additive are specialist senses; the business vaccine anchor alone does not establish appropriate scope or interchangeability.
Installing someone in office is a clear organizational meaning; the definition does not support treating every policy implementation as the same action.
Introducing liquid drop by drop is an explicit technical meaning relevant to administration of fluids; no injection technique or business financial meaning is inferred.
The verified armed-rebellion participant is a political specialist; the sole business insurgent anchor does not establish a commercial learning context.
Both entries only negate susceptible and leave the intended vulnerability explanation implicit; the old absolute disease-immunity claim cannot supply factual detail.
An outer protective covering with skin, feathers, rind and shell examples is a complete biological meaning; no universal toughness comparison is added.
The sole entry repeats interdependent without explaining mutual dependence; the proposed systemic relation needs a fuller sourced meaning.
Authoritative prohibition is a complete meaning matching ban; it does not require a military action or specific court procedure.
A material layer sandwiched between other layers is precise and relevant to materials interfaces; an abstract business interface is not implied.
Making a product suitable for international markets is fully explained with language and regional support, distinct from all broader globalization.
The only candidate repeats interpretation and does not establish the intended qualitative-research explanation; clearer learner-facing evidence is needed.
A relationship between multiple things is self-contained and appropriate to connected factors; it does not assert statistical correlation or causation.
The liquor or brew containing alcohol meaning is explicit and directly relevant to the alcohol anchor; other drug categories remain separate senses.
Between parts of the same molecule precisely distinguishes within-molecule relationships from broader molecular terminology.
Within one nation is a complete meaning for the national rather than household sense of domestic; retain non-comparability.
The evidence concerns spinal-canal drug delivery, not the fitness spinal anatomy anchor; do not introduce this clinical procedure specialist into exercise learning.
The power of creative imagination is explicit and supports creativity; a practical invention is not required for every instance.
A supervisor of examination students is a complete occupational meaning; retain Commonwealth, Ireland and UK labels and exclude generic monitoring roles.
The sole definition repeats inviolable and inviolableness without explaining the intended protected-rights meaning; old glosses are not factual evidence.
The strength-to-withstand-attack sense is explicit and relevant to safety; no real-world system is promised absolute freedom from harm.
Ion transport across media or membranes is a specialist biochemical concept, not an interchangeable fitness electrolyte term; the sole anchor does not justify the topic.
No exact plural military sense or reviewed irregular mapping is available; the proposed militia meaning remains unsupported by factual entries.
The explicit living-tissue responsiveness to stimuli matches academic sensitivity; exclude emotional anger and abnormal medical excitability senses.
The lowest of the three bones forming each side of the pelvis is a complete anatomical meaning appropriate to pelvic study.
The sole entry points to unexplained isohypse; an exact self-contained sense or explicitly reviewed cross-entry expansion is needed before release.
A map line joining equal-height points is a complete topographical meaning matching contour.
Aggressive military nationalism is verified but the sole business nationalist anchor does not establish a relevant commercial topic for this political specialist.
An intermediary buying and selling merchandise is explicit and appropriate to wholesaling; avoid the source's narrower pricing, stock-exchange and performance senses.
The sole entry repeats jockeys and does not verify the intended strategic competitive maneuvering meaning.
The short side-buckled riding boot is a complete exact-headword meaning; distinguish it from the Wiktionary attributive trouser form.
Judges collectively or a court system is explicit and relevant to legal institutions, without equating it with every individual tribunal.
Able to be evaluated and resolved by courts is a complete legal-terminology meaning; it is not a guarantee that a claim or contract is enforceable.
No exact factual English entry is available; a Latin-derived potassium name and its supposed preferred register cannot be inferred from the old gloss.
Fine clay rich in kaolinite with ceramic and papermaking uses is a clear materials meaning, not a substitute for every clay.
The nucleus of a cell is an exact and understandable biological meaning, excluding non-cellular senses of nucleus.
The nautical anchor and vessel-warping senses do not fit the fitness anchor context; no specialist maritime connection is promoted.
The drumhead over a hemispherical metal bowl identifies an instrument relevant to entertainment reading; the dated social-party sense is excluded.
No exact sourced entry supports this spelling in the current evidence; preserve hidden pending a verified spelling-variant identity mapping.
